title: Motech Products / Ads / Banners
description: A collection of renderings for products rendered and/or developed by myself, from ideation to manufacturing and sale. Photographs of final products can be found at kitchenbathcollection.com unless the product was bespoke or developed for B2B.

brief.label: Scope
brief.text: Product renders and listing imagery for Motech's kitchen and bath lines, for products I rendered or developed from ideation through manufacturing and sale.

brief.label: Channel
brief.text: Finished products sell online through kitchenbathcollection.com, and some were developed bespoke or for B2B customers.

study_intro: A rendering language built to sell furniture without a showroom: the image does the work a store floor used to.

study.label: Light
study.text: Soft, directional daylight and real interior staging: brass sconces, arched mirrors, tile and timber.

study.label: Color
study.text: Warm naturals and cream finishes against one dark wall, so the vanity is always the brightest object in the frame.

study.label: Series
study.text: Collections are named and shot side by side, so a buyer can compare finishes and mirrors at a glance.
